psd.title: Live2D PSD Reconstruction
psd.description: Experimental conversion for runtime Live2D assets. By default it exports an assembled full-character/scene PSD, and it can also export atlas-layer PSD files or repack PSD files with matching metadata back into texture PNG files.
psd.drop_main: Drop model3.json, .moc3, a model folder, or an exported PSD
psd.drop_sub: Full-character/scene PSD output uses Cubism Core ArtMesh data when available; atlas-layer PSD output is mainly for texture-coordinate round trips; PNG repack needs the matching .lpkpsd.json.
